## Goal

What user-visible defect or capability does this address?

## Change

Summarize the smallest useful change and mention architectural or Release-payload implications.

## Verification

```text
npm test
```

List focused tests and consumer-facing checks actually run. Label evidence as configuration-only, protocol-only, offline regression or live. Do not paste secrets or transcripts.

## Documentation

- [ ] README / installation / usage updated where needed
- [ ] Protocol and evidence boundaries updated where needed
- [ ] Release notes or install instructions updated where needed

## Privacy and authorization

- [ ] No credentials, cookies, account UUIDs, private endpoints, logs, user data, caches or personal state are added
- [ ] No live browser/account/external-network experiment occurred outside the authorized scope
- [ ] Production/runtime ownership remains on immutable Release assets, not a development tree

## Rollback

Describe the safe revert or rollback path.
